reference_sql:
SELECT month, eur_per_unit,
  ROUND(AVG(eur_per_unit) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 4) AS avg_rate_3m,
  COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS months_in_window
FROM fx_rates_monthly
WHERE currency = 'USD'
  AND month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
alternatives:
WITH r AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT month, eur_per_unit
  FROM fx_rates_monthly
  WHERE currency = 'USD'
    AND month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT m.month, m.eur_per_unit, ROUND(AVG(p.eur_per_unit), 4) AS avg_rate_3m, COUNT(*) AS months_in_window
FROM r m
JOIN r p ON p.month BETWEEN m.month - INTERVAL 2 MONTH AND m.month
GROUP BY m.month, m.eur_per_unit

WITH w AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT month, eur_per_unit,
    AVG(eur_per_unit) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_3m,
    COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM fx_rates_monthly
  WHERE currency = 'USD'
    AND month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT month, eur_per_unit, ROUND(avg_3m, 4) AS avg_rate_3m, n AS months_in_window
FROM w

other_way.sql:
WITH r AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT month, eur_per_unit
  FROM fx_rates_monthly
  WHERE currency = 'USD'
    AND month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT m.month, m.eur_per_unit, ROUND(AVG(p.eur_per_unit), 4) AS avg_rate_3m, COUNT(*) AS months_in_window
FROM r m
JOIN r p ON p.month BETWEEN m.month - INTERVAL 2 MONTH AND m.month
GROUP BY m.month, m.eur_per_unit
other_way.tradeoff: Joining each month to the 2 months before it gives the same averages without a window, but only because no month is missing.

solver.query:
SELECT CAST(month AS DATE) AS month, eur_per_unit,
       ROUND(AVG(eur_per_unit) OVER w, 4) AS avg_rate_3m,
       COUNT(*) OVER w AS months_in_window
FROM fx_rates_monthly
WHERE currency = 'USD' AND CAST(month AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY CAST(month AS DATE) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
